\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,amsthm}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}

\title{A Positive Number with an Even Double}
\author{A synthetic example}
\date{}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:double}
There is a positive natural number $n$ such that $n + n$ is even.
\end{theorem}

\end{document}
